tests.name: orb active-provider (orb route module) still answers

tests.reason: The fix is session start/stop telemetry. Producing a real start or stop row needs a real ORB voice session, which writes to the production Supabase project, so read-only anonymous staging probes cannot create one. These suites drive the real WS start (adapter -> controller), the WS stop_session handler, socket-close cleanup, the idle sweep and POST stop, proving exactly one start and one stop per WS session with the merged fields and the live session id. After PUBLISH, a read-only oasis_events count of start vs DISTINCT session_id by metadata->>'transport' confirms it.
Standing regression suites (CLAUDE.md 42c/42e/42h) stay green; the change touches orb-live.ts and the session controller.
